text:
alex_sales: Heads-up team — MediQore procurement needs a compliance proofpack to finalize the SOW. Ask list: redacted SOC 2 control matrix excerpt, ISO27001 scope snippet (if possible), signed penetration test attestation for our isolated staging env addressed to their Head of Security, and a quick nonbinding delta for shipping an on-prem VM vs hosted POC. Can we turn this in by EOD Thursday? @priya_se @kai_compliance @omar_sec

priya_se: I can pull the on-prem delta. Quick clarifying q: do they want an OVA or a container image? Packaging/validation differs. Ballpark for OVA packaging + QA: $9k-$14k one-time, runbook + ops support $1.6k/mo. If they want us to coordinate pentest windows add ~$1k per window. I'll pin a number by EOD.

kai_compliance: For SOC2 we can provide the control matrix excerpt + cover/scope page. We'll redact internal hostnames, employee IDs, and CI/CD pipeline names. ISO27001: we have a scope statement PDF; I can extract a short excerpt. Need ~24 hours to prepare redacted signed PDFs.

omar_sec: Pen-test attestation: we can provide a signed letter confirming that an accredited third-party performed a penetration test scoped to the isolated staging cluster. We will not include vulnerability details. If MediQore wants their vendor to run tests, require an NDA addendum, POA from Legal, scoped CIDR, and a 2-4 hour maintenance window. That option adds ~2 business days for legal approvals.

alex_sales: MediQore's Head of Security (jen.s) prefers CIDR in the letter. Any blockers to saying "CIDR available on request" instead?

omar_sec: Prefer to avoid placing IPs/CIDRs in a signed public letter. We can state "CIDR available upon mutual NDA" and provide it out-of-band. Legal will need to approve if they insist on embedding CIDR.

priya_se: Minimal network sketch for the bundle (can paste into the packet):

```
[Internet] -> Ingress LB -> Bastion (jumpbox) -> Isolated Staging VPC (no prod peering)
Management subnet separated; telemetry exported read-only to S3.
```

kai_compliance: I'll prepare the SOC2 control matrix excerpt and the ISO scope snippet. ETA tomorrow morning. I'll redact hostnames and add a short note about redaction methodology for their auditors.

omar_sec: Draft attestation snippet (for Legal review):

```
[Redwood Inference Letterhead]
To: Head of Security, MediQore
Re: Penetration Test Attestation  Staging Environment
Redwood Inference confirms that an accredited third-party performed a penetration test focused on the isolated staging environment used for the MediQore POC. The assessment was limited to the staging cluster and associated ingress points. Detailed findings and remediation steps are withheld; a high-level summary may be provided under NDA. This attestation does not authorize access to production systems.
Signed,
[Director, Security]
```

alex_sales: Evidence-bot  please open a ticket and attach a checklist so procurement doesn't stall.

evidence-bot: Created ticket EVID-7250 "MediQore proofpack" with checklist: SOC2 excerpt, ISO27001 scope snippet, pentest attestation, NDA addendum template, network isolation diagram. Owner: alex_sales.

alex_sales: Next steps: Priya  firm on-prem delta by EOD; Kai  SOC2+ISO snippet by tomorrow AM; Omar  route attestation to Legal today. I'll give MediQore a nonbinding estimate to keep procurement moving. Thanks all :thumbsup:
